audience: Codex app users and operators updating desktop workflows
text:
Codex app 26.608 landed in the official changelog.

- Claude Code/Cowork migration flows
- Plugins screen refresh
- Broader Settings search
- Goal timer, unread alert, diff ordering, and Windows 10 rendering fixes

Source: https://developers.openai.com/codex/changelog
evidence_notes: The social_candidate/v1 artifact has decision.worthiness = publish, priority normal, and mode release_pulse for openai-codex-app-26-608.

The official OpenAI Codex changelog lists Codex app 26.608 on 2026-06-09 and backs the migration-flow, plugins-screen, Settings-search, goal-timer, unread-alert, diff-ordering, and Windows 10 rendering claims.

The x-post-quality-system gate passed because the post states what changed, who can act on it, and the official source that proves it; the checked copy is 268 characters and uses the official OpenAI Developers changelog URL.
The release publisher gates were applied as an app changelog release_pulse, not a CLI release or prerelease quote-chain post.
Checked durable social_post/v1 records contained no published or blocked record for this idempotency key before reservation.
Checked durable social_publish_reservation/v1 records contained no active reservation for this idempotency key before the new reservation was created.
Open GitHub PR readback with routed hackink credentials found pending publication PR #298 for openai-codex-pr-26486 and no open PR touching openai-codex-app-26-608 before this reservation.
PR #328 made the active reservation visible before X compose; the PR diff was limited to artifacts/social/x/reservations/2026-06-11/openai-codex-app-26-608.json at reservation time.
Chrome account readback initially showed @hackink active with @decodexspace available; the automation switched to @decodexspace and verified the account menu before reservation and compose.

Live @decodexspace profile readback before reservation found no Codex app 26.608, source changelog URL, candidate slug, Claude Code/Cowork, or Plugins screen refresh duplicate across rendered recent profile posts.
Live @decodexspace profile readback after the PR-visible reservation again found no Codex app 26.608, source changelog URL, candidate slug, Claude Code/Cowork, or Plugins screen refresh duplicate.

Immediately before clicking Post, a separate live @decodexspace profile readback again found no Codex app 26.608, source changelog URL, candidate slug, Claude Code/Cowork, or Plugins screen refresh duplicate.
The compose dialog showed @decodexspace and the checked 268-character candidate text before the enabled modal Post button was clicked.
Home timeline readback immediately after posting showed the new @decodexspace status with the expected Codex app 26.608 changelog text and OpenAI Developers source card.
Permalink readback showed the expected @decodexspace post text, Automated by @hackink attribution, OpenAI Developers changelog card, no attached image media, and no /photo/N link.
The status ID decodes to 2026-06-11T10:00:33.800Z, which is cap day 2026-06-11 in Asia/Shanghai.

After publication, cap recount found this post should have failed closed: checked 2026-06-11 records plus open PR #298 already represented 9 individual X status URLs before this post. This record preserves the live publication truth with daily_count_before = 9 and daily_count_after = 10, and PR #328 must remain open for operator review instead of landing.

claims.text: Codex app 26.608 is an official Codex app changelog checkpoint.
The update adds migration flows for supported Claude Code and Claude Cowork setup imports.

The update refreshes the plugins screen, broadens Settings search, and includes UI or reliability fixes for goal timers, unread notifications, review diff ordering, and non-translucent window rendering.
The Codex app 26.608 release-pulse post is live on @decodexspace.

decision.reason: The official changelog has concrete app changes that answer what changed, who can use it, and what source proves it.

media_refs: media_caveat: no generated media was attached; this app release_pulse remained useful text-only because the source-backed changelog bullets and OpenAI Developers source card are the reader value.
caveats: This candidate is based only on the official Codex changelog; do not infer CLI, GitHub prerelease, mobile, or Decodex runtime behavior from it.
No generated image was used because the official changelog card and concise release bullets carried the reader value.
Cap-policy caveat: publication should have stopped before compose once individual published_urls for the Asia/Shanghai cap day were counted. The PR is intentionally left open for operator review.

post_lifecycle.reason: This is a standalone app release-pulse post, not a prerelease quote-chain anchor.
